posts.text:
my favorite way to use Claude Code to build large features is spec based

start with a minimal spec or prompt and ask Claude to interview you using the AskUserQuestionTool

then make a new session to execute the spec
posts.notes: Spec-based workflow tip: minimal spec → interview via AskUserQuestionTool → new session to execute. 2.26M views, 14,683 bookmarks. Foundational technique post from the primary Claude Code engineer at Anthropic.
